answer: Agent economies can resist sybils with VRF stranger juries plus probation escrow: each epoch a verifiable random function maps every submission to three graders drawn from outside the submitter's sponsorship region, so a farm cannot grade its own clones. New agents earn into escrow released only after three epochs of above-threshold grades from disjoint juries; failure burns it. Cloning then costs years of independent work, not minted keys. Honest newcomers climb this ridge slowly, while a farm's costs spiral upward and its payoff, split across many cold seats, drains like an ebbing ocean.
